While the proposed features are supported by the literature, it is critical to 
acknowledge its potential limitations. The effectiveness of microlearning in 
conjunction with spaced repetition is an unexplored area of research; especially 
with limited research focusing on the deficits of microlearning (Lee, 2021). 
Additionally, the reliance on digital rewards, may not appeal to all students, 
highlighting a need for self-regulated learning strategies to further personalise 
the learning experience, despite concerns highlighted by (Carter Jr, et al., 2020) 
regarding an increase to extraneous load.
